Name: Convenient Chests
Author: Solariz
Description:
Combines features of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1787]StackToNearbyChests[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1300]CategorizeChests[/url], and allows crafting from nearby chests.

[b][size=4]Usage[/size][/b]
Press hotkey (default: Q / right stick on controller) to auto-stash items to nearby chests that have been tagged for that item or already contain it.
If you want to use the global auto-stash feature (default: Z), you will first need to enable it in the config.json

[b][size=4]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=4]Found a bug?
[/size][/b]Please submit bugs on the [url=https://github.com/aEnigmatic/StardewValley/issues]github issue tracker[/url]﻿.

[b][size=4]Known problems[/size][/b][list]
[*]Remote Fridges Storage will cause cooking to not use up the ingredients. (This should be fixed in the newest version? Please comment :)
[*]Farmhands cannot save their categories due to how the game handles locations, sorry.
[/list]
